about: The farm app suite: one list of apps for every app's 'Farm apps' menu. Master copy: herd-planner/brand/suite-apps.json. Set an app's url when it goes live; null shows 'Coming soon'. 'company' is the company site every app links back to (top left and the top of this menu); change its name and url here when the company is named. 'account' is the suite's one home page for people signed in (farm-account; called My Farm since 2026-10-11, at apps.cornerpostlogic.com since 2026-10-12), linked at the bottom of this menu (suite version 10; the top right before) in every app but itself. 'groups' (suite version 7, 2026-10-11) sorts the apps in every Farm Apps menu the way the company site's menu does, by operation; an app in no group isn't shown. A group's 'soon' (suite version 10, 2026-10-14) lists apps still being built, by id, name and one line: each shows in that group as a greyed Coming Soon row that opens nothing; move it to 'apps' (and the group's 'apps') when it opens.

soon.name: Hay & Feed Planner
soon.what: Winter hay needs and what they cost

apps.name: Yield Predictor
apps.what: County crop yields from weather, soils and irrigation

apps.name: Grazing Planner
apps.what: This season's grass and how many head a pasture can carry

apps.name: Farm Equipment Planner
apps.what: Whether a tractor, combine or implement pays for itself
